title: selinum razulii
intro: Selinum razulii, commonly known as Wild celery, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of China. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Selinum razulii are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as arthritis and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Selinum razulii include coumarins, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
